title: senna viciifolia
intro: Senna viciifolia, commonly known as Kali jiro or wild senna, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as relief from digestive issues, including constipation and diarrhea, due to its ability to stimulate bowel movements. The therapeutic actions of Senna viciifolia include purgative and laxative effects, which are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including anthraquinone glycosides like sensnosides A and B. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's overall efficacy in treating gastrointestinal disorders.
